name: Doom
short_description: Doom, on a badge or on a desktop
long_description: Doom, on a badge or on a desktop. One package, one engine per platform: an ESP32-S3 badge runs the engine from flash as a littlefs2e extent (no executable RAM needed), a desktop runs the native module. The first launch unpacks the bundled shareware WAD into RAM, so expect a short 'Unpacking WAD' screen every time. Includes the shareware episode DOOM1.WAD; the engine is GPL v2 or later and its source is at github.com/MicroPythonOS/MicroPythonOS (c_mpos/doom). Licenses are in the app (hold the menu touch area). On a badge, the app needs a MicroPythonOS with littlefs2e extents; the store lists it for ESP32-S3 badges and x64 desktops.
